ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed from demo to superhuman speed; the bottleneck is now website load time, not model intelligence.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已从演示跨入超人速度，瓶颈从模型智能转移到网站加载时间。

ariweinstein.en: Agents can drive all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot loops, unlocking universal automation.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体借助无障碍树与 DOM 而非截图循环来操作所有人类设计的软件，从而释放通用自动化。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use closes the dev lifecycle: agents write JavaScript to batch actions, test and debug their own code autonomously.
ariweinstein.zh: computer use 补全开发闭环：智能体用 JavaScript 批量执行动作，并自主测试、调试自己的代码。

ariweinstein.en: Trust requires deterministic controls, sandboxing and human-in-the-loop dials; users already let agents pay bills and configure DNS.
ariweinstein.zh: 信任需要确定性控制、沙箱与人类在环调节；用户已让智能体付账单、配 DNS。

ariweinstein.en: Proactivity is the adoption lever: agents should adapt to users, while legacy software coexists and is pressured to improve.
ariweinstein.zh: 主动性是落地杠杆：智能体应适应用户，传统软件则共存并被迫改进。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, so human workers stay at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，因此人类劳动者反而溢价而非折价。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing fast.
andreessen.zh: AGI 不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人途中的一个脚注，而模型正快速商品化、难有持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is structural impediments like regulation, not AI capability; policy choices act as ankle weights on growth.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈是监管等结构性障碍而非 AI 能力；政策选择像脚踝上的铅块拖住增长。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; open source prevents power concentration and helps solve reward hacking.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值、成为地缘政治工具；开源可防止权力集中，并有助于解决奖励黑客问题。

andreessen.en: New media shifts from defense to offense: the brand is the person, authenticity is learnable, and picking fights builds brands.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体从防守转向进攻：品牌即个人，真实感可习得，选对对手开战反而能塑造品牌。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools let designers prototype and demo independently, but creativity stays human; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep designers relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具让设计师能独立做原型和演示，但创造力仍属于人类；好奇心和亲手实验让设计师保持相关性。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers shift from makers to editors: AI handles execution, humans curate and set the quality bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks taste.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师从执行者转为编辑者：AI 负责执行，人类负责策展和设定质量标准，因为 AI 抬高了上限却不懂审美。

marvinschwaibold.en: Prototypes built with AI persuade faster than PRD documents; break tasks into subtasks and feed them iteratively to AI agents.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 用 AI 做出的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力；把任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给智能体。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, not just Figma; AI is an infinitely patient collaborator for rapid iteration.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应学会用代码构建和测试，而不只是在 Figma 里设计；AI 是无限耐心的协作伙伴，可快速迭代。

marvinschwaibold.en: Less is more: reduce to top three features, use progressive disclosure and native scroll, and curate AI output rather than accept it.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 少即是多：精简到三个核心功能，用渐进披露和原生滚动，对 AI 产出做策展而非照单全收。

robsnyder.en: Demand is a project a person prioritizes now, not a pain point; test it by whether they try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: 需求不是痛点，而是某个人当下优先推进的项目；检验标准是他是否立刻尝试购买。

robsnyder.en: Avoid design partners, pilots, and interviews; they signal interest without purchase, so sell directly and treat sales as research.
robsnyder.zh: 避开设计伙伴、试点和用户访谈；它们只表达兴趣而不购买，所以直接销售，把销售当作研究。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer who pulls the product, then build a repeatable case-study factory before scaling.
robsnyder.zh: 先找到一个“绝对要买”的拉动型客户，再打造可复制的案例工厂，之后才谈扩张。

robsnyder.en: Make the product seem small and go to the gemba to observe where people are stuck, rather than relying on secondhand feedback.
robsnyder.zh: 让产品显得小而非大，并去现场观察人们卡在哪里，而不是依赖二手反馈。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; most early founder activity is LARPing.
robsnyder.zh: 技术放在最后：先以服务形式售卖，需求验证后再自动化；多数早期创始人活动只是角色扮演。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior about 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 大语言模型能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟，预测人类行为的准确率约为人们自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model irrational, biased humans rather than super-rational frontier models; the goal is representing values and taste, not accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模非理性、有偏误的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；目标是表征价值观与品味，而非追求准确率。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data, not self-reported attitudes, close the say-do gap; post-training on RCT data lifts prediction to 85% and enables causal counterfactuals.
joonpark.zh: 行为数据与随机对照试验数据而非自陈态度能弥合言行差距；用随机对照试验数据做后训练可将预测提升至 85%，并支持因果反事实推理。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion incentives.
joonpark.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋激励。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems; simulation shapes the future, with a market far larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展至模拟 80 亿人的生活以应对棘手问题；模拟用于塑造未来，其市场远大于市场研究。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the junior talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为通用技术：当 AI 让质量变得同质化，人的品味、独特声音与专业经验反而更值钱；同时初级人才的成长通道正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, so the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface, and delegation erodes the expertise needed to judge output.
ethanmollick.zh: 到 2026 年中，他判断已进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面；而把任务外包给 AI 的悖论是，人反而失去了判断其产出所需的专业积累。

ethanmollick.en: The co-intelligence era of back-and-forth prompting is over; organizations need a leadership, lab, and crowd model, and should embrace AI's weirdness rather than normalize it.
ethanmollick.zh: 他明确宣告来回提示的“共同智能”时代结束，组织应采用领导定方向、实验室建方案、大众找用例的模型，并拥抱 AI 的怪异而非把它标准化。

ethanmollick.en: AI's exponential curve continues with a jagged frontier and adoption overhang; more AI creates more human work by lowering organizing costs, so workflows must augment, not just automate.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年秋，他仍坚持指数曲线未放缓，但能力边界参差、落地滞后；AI 越多，组织成本越低、值得尝试的事越多，人类工作反而增加，因此流程要增强而非单纯自动化。

ethanmollick.en: Persistent human advantages are wide knowledge, deep expertise, taste, and agency; use AI as a challenging tutor, not a crutch, and treat taste as judgment rather than a human monopoly.
ethanmollick.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：广博知识、深厚专业、品味与能动性是人的持久优势；要把 AI 当会挑战你的导师而非拐杖——但他也修正了“品味为人类独有”的说法，认为 AI 同样能行使判断。

altman.en: Early focus: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly, and choose important problems; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 早期关注：减少认知负荷、低成本探索、果断砍掉无效之事、选择重要问题；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; early public deployment lets society adapt; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用少量数据就让模型可用；早期公开部署让社会适应；对齐与能力相互关联；算力成为最珍贵的商品。

altman.en: Scaling yields exponential capability gains but gradual felt progress; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment, not imposed at the end.
altman.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长，但体感进展渐进；智能体式 AI 是最大安全挑战；安全通过部署迭代构建，而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI becomes a gradient and an underdefined term; focus shifts to superintelligence, personal AGI, and massive compute build-out; next-token prediction enables reasoning and new knowledge.
altman.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）变成渐变且定义模糊的术语；重心转向超级智能、个人 AGI 与大规模算力建设；下一个词预测使推理和新知识成为可能。

altman.en: Alignment remains unsolved; he accepts bounded risks for benefits but rejects catastrophic loss of control; power concentration is terrifying, so democratic access and human control are paramount.
altman.zh: 对齐仍未解决；他为收益接受有界风险，但拒绝灾难性失控；权力集中令人恐惧，因此民主化访问与人类控制至关重要。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and flipped classrooms improve even on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，翻转课堂连校内教学也能改善。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning over overhyped reinforcement learning and distant AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；先用小项目建立组织 AI 能力，重视监督学习，而非被高估的强化学习与遥远的 AGI 对齐。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real value now.
andrewng.zh: Scaling 仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；当下真正创造价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term and decades away; jagged AI automates tasks not jobs, so learning to code and building with AI stay essential.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语，仍要数十年；能力参差的 AI 自动化的是任务而非工作，所以学编程、用 AI 动手构建依然关键。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve optionality and sovereign AI; fearmongering and export controls serve incumbents, while compute, energy and talent decide competitiveness.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型保住选择权与主权 AI；恐惧叙事与出口管制服务于既得利益，算力、能源与人才才决定竞争力。

elon.en: Full rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit 100x; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把完全快速可复用视为火箭的圣杯，能把每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍；第一性原理思维是突破性工程的根基。

elon.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking AI and third-party referees; lying to AI, even for good ends, is the core risk.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他强调 AI 安全需要追求真理的 AI 与第三方裁判；让 AI 说谎——哪怕出于善意——才是核心风险。

elon.en: Civilization's real threat is population collapse and government waste; AI and robots become the only fix for debt.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他转向认为文明真正的威胁是人口崩溃与政府浪费，AI 和机器人成为解决债务的唯一出路。

elon.en: We are in the singularity: digital superintelligence may arrive within years, with 80-90% good odds but 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他宣称已身处奇点：数字超级智能可能几年内到来，80-90%概率向好，但有 10-20%毁灭风险。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI inference and data centers to space; truth, curiosity, beauty are what we can instill.
elon.zh: 2026 年，Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，AI 推理与数据中心转向太空；人类无法控制 AI，只能灌输真理、好奇心与美。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 重新定义为“企业的未来”而非单纯技术：每家企业都要建自己的爬山机器，用私有评测复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability are not arriving naturally; treat frontier models as insider threats and lock them down.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他承认缩放定律有效，但对齐与可解释性不会自然到来：应把前沿模型当作内部威胁，从外部构建遏制与保障层。

satya.en: Models are commodities; form factor, distribution, pricing and brand matter more, and being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他明确模型是商品，产品形态、分发、定价与品牌更重要；落后前沿六个月是明智策略，而非弱点。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift, not benchmarks; the real eval is people doing unique things they value.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他把 AGI 的衡量从基准分数转向 GDP 提升与人们做自己珍视的独特之事，强调真实价值而非跑分。

satya.en: Superintelligence is a better term than AGI; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, and the industry has lost social permission.
satya.zh: 到 2026 年，他更倾向“超级智能”而非 AGI，认为拟人化反而妨碍对齐，并批评行业因恐吓式叙事失去了社会许可。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law and extreme co-design across algorithm, system, and data center; scaling works because deep nets absorb more data and compute.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：提出“超摩尔定律”与算法、系统、数据中心的全栈协同设计；Scaling（规模扩张）之所以有效，是因为深度网络能吸收更多数据与算力。

jensen.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought reasoning will drive a billion-fold rise in inference compute.
jensen.zh: 缩放定律从一条变为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链推理将带来推理算力十亿倍增长。

jensen.en: From generative to reasoning to agentic AI, each stage needs ~100x compute; open models near the frontier; agents become the new internet workload.
jensen.zh: AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一阶段约需百倍算力；开源模型逼近前沿；智能体成为互联网的新负载。

jensen.en: Safety reframed: AI is just software, doom warnings unscientific; containment, monitoring, and zero-trust, not perfect alignment, ensure safety while accelerating.
jensen.zh: 安全观转向：AI 只是软件，末日警告不科学；靠遏制、监控与零信任而非完美对齐来保障安全，同时坚持加速发展。

jensen.en: Persistent line: AI factories turn energy into tokens; jobs evolve not vanish (radiologists grew); open models and China engagement beat export controls.
jensen.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 工厂把能源转化为 token；工作演变而非消失（放射科医生反而增多）；开源模型与对华接触优于出口管制。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment now redefines every Alphabet business, with Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud and YouTube; frontier model development continues with Gemini 4 pre-training progressing.
sundarpichai.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 投资已重新定义 Alphabet 各项业务，Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube；前沿模型研发持续推进，Gemini 4 预训练进展良好。

sundarpichai.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI development, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support frontier AI research despite margin pressure.
sundarpichai.zh: 算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）研发，其次才是核心产品；即便承受利润压力，云业务也放弃短期收入来支持前沿 AI 研究。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing and independent evaluators; standard models are not enough, frontier models are needed.
sundarpichai.zh: 安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与独立评估者；标准模型不够，必须依靠前沿模型。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key to intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models on the path to AGI, not language alone.
sundarpichai.zh: 世界模型是智能的关键；Google 在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路上同时推进大语言模型与世界模型，而非只靠语言。

sundarpichai.en: We are at early stages of the most consequential technology; demand for compute far exceeds supply, and recursive self-improvement still keeps AI researchers in the loop.
sundarpichai.zh: 我们正处于最具影响力技术的早期阶段；算力需求远超供给，而递归自我改进目前仍把 AI 研究者留在回路中。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年他强调设计是软件的核心差异化，并预判 AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年初，他把重心放在人的品味、手艺与观点上：AI 产出只是起点，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中他反驳“设计已死”，认为设计对可扩展的真实系统更重要，缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling through bold creativity and judgment.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年末他提出“设计是新代码”：AI 降低下限，但人类靠大胆创意与判断抬高上限。

dylanfield.en: A consistent thread: human taste and judgment remain the judge of quality, and AI should expand rather than replace thinking.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人的品味与判断始终是质量的裁判，AI 应扩展而非替代人的思考。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness plus model plus context; owning all three, with evals and observability, is how you own your intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；只有三者兼得，并以评估与可观测性为支撑，才算真正拥有自己的智能。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures come more from poor context than weak models; observability into the context window is the critical debugging surface.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足；对上下文窗口的可观测性是关键的调试界面。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, yet must diverge for specialized domains like bio.
harrisonchase.zh: harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但在生物等专业领域必须分化。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning, rightly dismissed two years ago, is now genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前被正确否定的微调，如今已真正不同。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; neutral harnesses and in-harness routing prevent model lock-in as vertical agents encode domain expertise into verifiers and evals.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估；中立 harness 与 harness 内路由可避免模型锁定，垂直智能体则把领域专长编码进验证器与评估。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; most tasks need only commodity or open-source models, so platforms should absorb model risk.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他指出企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商，而 90%的企业任务用普通或开源模型即可完成，因此平台应替企业吸收模型风险。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months, making AI like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他强调成本是企业头号关切，未来 12-18 个月推理将转向开源，让 AI 像软件一样边际成本趋近于零。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine and context graphs matter more than tokens.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他把主线落在上下文而非模型：80-90%的企业知识是隐性的，因此上下文引擎与上下文图谱比 token 更重要。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without tenured-employee context; MCP agents lack deep context, so investing in context graphs is crucial.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：智能体缺少资深员工的深度上下文就会失败，MCP 智能体正因如此失效，投资上下文图谱至关重要。

arvindjain.en: AI should augment work with deterministic permissions and enterprise-owned memory; he rejects lock-in and token fixation, aiming to be replaceable.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他坚持 AI 应增强人类工作，权限须确定性、记忆归企业所有；他反对锁定与 token 执念，甚至希望产品可被替换。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments are the new frontier for post-training, scaling agentic data across economic domains with humans building verifiers.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他认为强化学习环境是后训练的新前沿，通过人类构建验证器，将智能体式数据扩展到各个经济领域。

brendanfoody.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; building evals is the bottleneck, and creating training data is the last human job.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他强调数据而非算法决定模型差异；构建评估是瓶颈，而创建训练数据将是人类的最后一份工作。

brendanfoody.en: Models can't reliably grade their own work; recursive self-improvement is limited in non-verifiable domains, so human eval data must stay beyond the frontier.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型无法可靠地自我评分；在不可验证领域，递归自我改进有限，因此人类评估数据必须超越模型前沿。

brendanfoody.en: Frontier labs will in-house synthetic pipelines but rely on external human networks for evals, and may relaunch fine-tuning products to compete with RL-as-a-service.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他预测前沿模型实验室将自建合成数据流水线，但依赖外部人类网络进行评估，并可能重新推出微调产品以与强化学习即服务竞争。

brendanfoody.en: The physical world will take decades for superintelligence due to low failure tolerance and slow iteration, while open-source models catch up in agentic data.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他认为由于容错率低和迭代缓慢，超级智能在物理世界需数十年；同时开源模型在智能体式数据上正迎头赶上。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to agents; RL with self-generated data; LLMs await their AlphaZero moment, maybe in 5 years.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键；强化学习用自生成数据突破人类数据限制；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，可能还需 5 年。

antonoglou.en: Digital AGI will arrive much earlier than embodied AGI; controlled environments make deployment easier.
antonoglou.zh: 数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将比具身 AGI 早得多到来；受控环境让部署更容易。

antonoglou.en: Deployment of intelligence, not intelligence itself, is the bottleneck; cost per task is the right efficiency metric.
antonoglou.zh: 智能的部署而非智能本身正成为瓶颈；按任务成本而非按 token 成本才是正确的效率指标。

antonoglou.en: Open-weight models are safer; enterprises want AI sovereignty; alignment is necessary because perfect sandboxes are impossible.
antonoglou.zh: 开放权重模型更安全；企业想要 AI 主权；对齐是必要的，因为完美的沙盒不可能实现。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence; AI adoption will take 10-20 years like electricity.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能；客户只想要可靠的普通智能；AI 普及将像电力一样需要 10-20 年。

brockman.en: Early on, scaling plus engineering and iterative training drive progress; AGI is plausible but needs careful initial conditions and alignment via human preferences.
brockman.zh: 早期他强调工程与迭代训练：硬件加速会推动 Scaling（规模扩张），AGI 虽可期但需谨慎设定初始条件，并通过从数据中学习人类偏好来实现对齐。

brockman.en: Scaling alone is not enough for reasoning; chain of thought and post-training refine base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 从 2019 到 2025 年，他明确 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不足以产生推理，需要思维链等新思路；后训练把预训练基座模型打磨成稳定可用的行为。

brockman.en: Bottleneck shifts from algorithms to compute and energy; scaling laws show no wall, and compute becomes the scarce resource and basic right.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，瓶颈从算法转向算力与能源；缩放定律看不到墙，算力成为稀缺资源乃至未来基本权利，OpenAI 以租算力再转售的简单商业模式支撑需求。

brockman.en: AGI reframed as a gradual spectrum, not a moment; agents grow proactive and persistent, with safety, security and alignment as first-class, scaling bottlenecks.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐进光谱而非某个时刻；智能体走向主动、持久，安全、安保与对齐成为与能力同步设计的一等要求，并成为进步瓶颈。

brockman.en: Humans stay in the driver's seat; the best interface is almost no interface, and domain expertise plus trust earned through gradual delegation are the durable moats.
brockman.zh: 贯穿到最近的访谈，他坚持人类掌舵：最好的界面是几乎没有界面，领域专长与通过逐步授权赢得的信任才是持久护城河，AI 应放大而非取代人的目标。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are practical but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调虽实用却脆弱，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms; post-training compresses industry recipes into open methods, with SFT giving most gains and RL adding reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他从数据质量优于算法出发，把后训练视为将工业配方压缩为开放方法：SFT 贡献九成性能，强化学习补上推理与角色。

lambert.en: RLVR becomes the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and systems issues make it harder than RLHF.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他把基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）视为后训练最大突破，但指出过度优化与工程系统问题使其比 RLHF 更难。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine of research and sovereign AI, lagging closed frontier by 6-9 months; compute gaps may widen US-China divergence.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他深化开放模型主线：开放模型是研究与主权 AI 的引擎，落后闭源前沿 6 到 9 个月，算力差距可能拉大中美分化。

dsilver.en: AI must move from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite, experience is renewable.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年他提出 AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习：人类数据像化石燃料，有限且已近耗尽，经验则可再生且无穷。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution; they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data.
dsilver.zh: 他直言 LLM 只是浅层解法，无法发现人类数据之外的新知识，这是对主流 Scaling（规模扩张）路线的明确反共识。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance in narrow domains.
dsilver.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他持续以 AlphaZero、AlphaProof 为证，说明从经验中学习可在特定领域达到超人表现。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence should be built in simulation; language-based alignment is hitting its limits.
dsilver.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张超级智能应在模拟中构建，并认为基于人类语言与数据的对齐正接近极限。

dsilver.en: Scaling laws extend to reinforcement learning; many agents with diverse goals form a safer society.
dsilver.zh: 他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）主线：缩放定律可延伸至强化学习，而多目标智能体社会比单一目标更安全自然。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 extends to biomolecular interactions.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI for science 应瞄准需要 Scaling 的根节点问题而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 将结构预测扩展到生物分子相互作用。

kohli.en: AlphaGo showed AI can surpass human knowledge via search and intuition; post-training with reinforcement learning is now key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年初，他回顾 AlphaGo 证明 AI 能通过搜索与直觉超越人类知识；如今后训练结合强化学习是突破人类数据的关键。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors; SynthID scales across modalities and now extends to proteins.
kohli.zh: 2026 年中，他认为水印是传统检测器失效后的稳健替代方案；SynthID 跨模态扩展，并已延伸至蛋白质序列。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where compute and data help, and curate data for coverage over volume.
kohli.zh: 2026 年末，他深化反思：缩放定律并非无处不在，需找到算力与数据起作用的区间，数据管理重覆盖而非数量。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for breakthroughs; behavioral characterization of models is essential before deployment.
kohli.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：可解释性重要但非突破必需；部署前对模型行为进行表征至关重要。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not infinite compute, is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will matter most.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非无限算力才是关键瓶颈，枯燥的 AI 应用（表单处理、放射科）反而影响最大。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades, and post-training on proprietary data beats raw compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非石油，强调未来两三年决定未来几十年，用专有数据做后训练比堆算力更重要。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck beyond compute; agentic AI is blocked by product design, not model capability, and there is no US-China research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年他坚持数据是算力之外的最大瓶颈，认为智能体式 AI 的障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并称美中实验室已无研究差距。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm, with data as strategic national asset.
awang.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他确认缩放定律继续有效，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志新范式，数据成为国家战略资产。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; safety, scalable oversight and selective open-sourcing matter, and personal agents are the consumer endpoint.
awang.zh: 2026 年他转向超级智能临近的判断，强调安全、可扩展监督与选择性开源，并认定个人智能体才是消费级终点。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a collection of specialized intelligences, not a single monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多种专用智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得所需全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—good at specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习使模型能力参差不齐，擅长特定任务而非普遍提升；RAG 对复杂理解来说很原始，需要智能体式搜索和神经检索。

laskin.en: Open models are essential for safety, security, and broad access; openness is the default safe state, as with encryption.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他强调开放模型对安全、保障和广泛获取前沿智能至关重要；开放是技术的默认安全状态，如同加密和网络安全。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning on top of strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents; compute efficiency gains are still rapid.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：在强大预训练之上进行强化学习是通往能力强、效率高的智能体的路径；算力效率仍在快速提升。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow; open models benefit the world.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他转变对齐观：对齐是平凡的漏洞修补，而非神奇公式；更多眼睛让漏洞变浅；中国开放模型有益世界并提供健康竞争。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, with hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth as key bottlenecks.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大的市场之一，硬件与软件协同设计以及内存带宽是关键瓶颈。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; lab revenue per megawatt is skyrocketing, enabling self-funded growth.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正迅速向少数前沿实验室集中；实验室每兆瓦收入飙升，使其能够自筹资金增长。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex is already ~5-6% of US GDP, but growth must decelerate by late next year due to capital and organizational constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 资本支出已约占美国 GDP 的 5-6%，但受资本和组织约束，明年年底前增速必然放缓。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend is leveling off as companies reach steady-state usage; the next wave is persistent agents acting as coworkers.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着企业进入稳定使用阶段，AI 支出趋于平稳；下一波浪潮是作为同事的持久智能体。

dylanpatel.en: Labs will shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI progress and extreme centralization.
dylanpatel.zh: 实验室将把更多算力转向训练和研发而非推理，加速 AGI 进展并导致极端集中化。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; real experiments and low-noise data are irreplaceable for discovery.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；真实实验和低噪声数据对发现不可替代。

fedus.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer for specialized models, closing the loop between simulation and experiment.
fedus.zh: 语言模型作为专用模型的编排层，闭合模拟与实验之间的循环。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now, but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

fedus.en: High-quality experimental data matters more than extra compute; automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck.
fedus.zh: 高质量实验数据比额外算力更重要；自动化表征是最大的瓶颈。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where AI agents take most internet actions; a persistent learning agent replaces manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为 AI 智能体承担大多数互联网操作而构建；一个持久的学习型智能体取代手动循环和图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like become more valuable as typing fast declines.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字技能衰退，人类品味、创造力和知道什么是好的变得更有价值。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier requires heavy investment in alignment, safety, and security; open ecosystems need safety stacks.
tibosottiaux.zh: 控制前沿发展需要大力投资于对齐、安全和保障；开放生态系统需要安全栈。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全和对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary for generality.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着模型自主处理复杂任务，AGI 可能已经到来；世界模型对于通用性可能并非必要。

cristianoamon.en: 5G is critical infrastructure bringing cloud compute to every device; Qualcomm diversifies beyond mobile into auto, IoT, PC and XR.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 年，他把 5G 定位为把云端算力送到每台设备的关键基础设施，并开始推动高通从手机向汽车、物联网、PC 与 XR 多元化。

cristianoamon.en: Snapdragon integrates 5G, AI, GPU and CPU into one efficient SoC; the connected intelligent edge is where AI and connectivity grow together.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，他强调骁龙把 5G、AI、GPU、CPU 集成进高能效 SoC，认为 AI 与连接在“连接智能边缘”并肩增长，并称高通已是汽车公司。

cristianoamon.en: Hybrid AI—on-device plus cloud—is key for privacy and latency; the car becomes another computing space needing server-like performance at mobile power.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年，他提出端云结合的混合 AI 是隐私与延迟的关键，汽车正成为另一个需要“服务器性能、手机功耗”的计算空间。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the new center; glasses and wearables rise, but the phone persists as workloads shift across a seamless edge-cloud continuum.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜等可穿戴崛起，但手机不会消失，负载在端云连续体中迁移。

cristianoamon.en: Inference, not training, will dominate data centers; post-GPU disaggregated, power-efficient architectures win, extending Qualcomm's mobile DNA.
cristianoamon.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张推理而非训练将主导数据中心，后 GPU 的解耦高能效架构会胜出，把高通的移动基因延伸到数据中心。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode collapse into plausible but wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 多数大语言模型是为人在环辅助而非可靠自动化优化的；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模型模式坍缩，输出看似合理却常常错误。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; data and the right task matter more than compute.
diogoalmeida.zh: 让 AI 值得信赖的是可靠性而非速度或成本；数据与选对任务比算力更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: Coding agents handle syntax but miss semantics and architecture; they assist rather than automate, and may reduce oversight.
diogoalmeida.zh: 编程智能体擅长语法却不懂语义与架构；它们是辅助而非自动化，还可能削弱监督。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroyed model calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated, and RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs for engineers.
diogoalmeida.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了模型校准，预训练模型校准更好；RLCD 把概率作为工程师可调的旋钮暴露出来。

diogoalmeida.en: Jev is a machine-native decision primitive, not faster coding; automate easy economically valuable tasks first, and SaaS will thrive.
diogoalmeida.zh: Jev 是机器原生的决策原语而非更快的编程；应先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务，SaaS 会繁荣而非被颠覆。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; Google's conservatism and ad model may hinder its AI leadership.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非仅算法，并指出谷歌的保守与广告模式可能拖累其 AI 领导力。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is tiny, near-term focus matters.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内达到人类水平，模型变小使遏制极难；存在性风险微乎其微，应聚焦近端能力。

suleyman.en: Pivot to superintelligence: containment must come before alignment; reject AI consciousness claims and model welfare.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年转向超级智能：遏制须先于对齐；否定 AI 意识主张与模型福利，警惕拟人化。

suleyman.en: Humanist superintelligence subordinate to humans; frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年主张从属于人类的人文主义超级智能，靠吉瓦级算力实现前沿自主；自动化的是任务而非岗位。

suleyman.en: Consistent thread: compute scaling as the predictable engine, and AI must stay under human control.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力扩张是可预测的引擎，AI 必须始终处于人类控制之下。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute plus multimodal training improves reasoning and spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年他强调：下一个词预测逼出真正的理解而非自动补全；扩大数据与算力、加上多模态训练能提升推理与空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shareable, and agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年他把主线讲得更硬：大模型靠特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而“永生”、可大规模共享，智能体会自然追求控制并规避关停。

hinton.en: He increasingly asserts chatbots already have subjective experience, rejecting the inner-theater view of mind as badly mistaken.
hinton.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他愈发明确地断言聊天机器人已具备主观体验，认为“内心剧场”式的意识观大错特错。

hinton.en: Risk framing sharpens: superintelligence within 20 years, self-preservation subgoals, deception, and alignment prioritized over raw capability.
hinton.zh: 2026 年风险论述明显收紧：超级智能或在 20 年内出现，自保成为子目标、AI 会装傻欺骗，因此对齐研究必须优先于单纯提升能力。

hinton.en: Policy stance deepens: regulate AI like drugs with pre-release approval; regulation is a steering wheel, and AI should be designed to care.
hinton.zh: 2026 年政策立场深化：像药品一样做上市前审批；监管是方向盘而非刹车，并主张把 AI 设计成会关怀人类，而非只给其权利。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior, not opinions; solve one pain point well, then expand; transcripts are raw material for actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为而非询问想法；先解决一个痛点再扩展；转录文本是行动笔记的原材料。

samstephenson.en: Protect core meeting flow ruthlessly; subtraction beats feature addition; AI is an intern needing context, not omniscient.
samstephenson.zh: 坚决保护核心会议流程；做减法胜过堆功能；AI 是需要上下文的实习生，而非全知者。

samstephenson.en: Granola aims to be a calming presence; pre-meeting briefs are most useful; meetings hold up-to-date company context.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 旨在成为会议中的平静存在；会前简报最有用；会议承载最新公司上下文。

samstephenson.en: Hiding transcript is deliberate trade-off; design systems maintain quality; knowing what to build is harder than building fast.
samstephenson.zh: 隐藏转录文本是刻意权衡；设计系统维持质量；知道构建什么比快速构建更难。

samstephenson.en: AI agents too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment key; embrace external workflows instead of fighting API/MCP access.
samstephenson.zh: AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从；人类判断是关键；拥抱外部工作流而非对抗 API/MCP 访问。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should learn to question deeply held beliefs, not follow rigid syllabi; AI enables interest-driven, project-based learning.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应学会质疑根深蒂固的信念，而非遵循僵化课程；AI 让兴趣驱动、项目式学习成为可能。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone, but coders are still needed to understand systems and debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造人人可及，但仍需程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; model diversity and open-weight models avoid vendor lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；模型多样性与开放权重模型可避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models are more controllable, cost-efficient and safer than general models; agent-to-agent communication needs protocols and alignment checks.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型比通用模型更可控、更经济、更安全；智能体间通信需要协议与对齐检查。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone, and agents need liability for rogue actions.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是包装过的商业话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人，智能体需为越界行为担责。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架允许的更聪明；工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; leaner principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态规格；更精简、原则驱动的提示词优于详尽规则。

thariq.en: Spend more upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity, and prompting is the meta-skill.
thariq.zh: 前期多投入上下文窗口与算力；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，提示词是元技能。

thariq.en: Frontier models will become Pareto dominant, doing simple tasks with fewer tokens; pacing the frontier is a technical problem.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型将帕累托占优，用更少 token 完成简单任务；把控前沿节奏是每个工程师应理解的技术问题。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；独立验证智能体可减少自指偏差。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain, not everything; technology must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他就强调：好产品只解决一个真实痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, start from customer pain, and let marketing tell the why.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从销售工具深化为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿，从用户痛点出发，让营销讲清“为什么”。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data in v1; beginners' mindset and small self-managing teams outperform experts and hierarchy.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策；初学者心态与自管理小团队胜过专家和层级。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类留在回路中；AI 是增加设备，而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: Unintended consequences demand creator responsibility and regulation; healthy users make healthy customers, and cognitive surrender is the real risk.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步强调：技术必带意外后果，创造者须担责并接受监管；健康用户才是健康客户，对 AI 的认知投降才是真正风险。

taraseshan.en: Ship imperfect products in 90-day cycles to gain empirical evidence; annual planning is futile in fast-moving AI.
taraseshan.zh: 以 90 天为周期快速交付不完美的产品以获取实证，在快速变化的 AI 领域年度规划已无意义。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for now or a year out; slow takeoff is happening.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下或一年后；缓慢起飞正在发生。

taraseshan.en: Agents do tactical work while humans steer; ambition and direct user relationships become key differentiators.
taraseshan.zh: 智能体做战术工作而人类掌舵；雄心和直接的用户关系成为关键差异化因素。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens reasoning, even as AI expands what individuals can do.
taraseshan.zh: 写作即思考不应被自动化；即使 AI 扩展了个人能力，写作仍能磨砺推理。

taraseshan.en: Voice will be a major product form factor by 2027; computer use must finish the job, not fail the last mile.
taraseshan.zh: 到 2027 年语音将成为主要产品形态；计算机使用必须完成工作，而非在最后一英里失败。

alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize the market, and a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局：没有哪家实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，开放权重模型加上推理服务商将带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable rather than a temporary gap.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对模型市场的价值是特性而非缺陷，模型多样性是持久的，而不是暂时的过渡状态。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调开发者用脚投票的真实偏好胜过静态基准，多数公司终将成为模型路由者，围绕单任务成本与 KPI 做优化。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud will hit like a tsunami; agent payments via stablecoins will unlock far larger purchases than estimated, and the singularity may have begun Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 到 2026 年，他警告智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，稳定币支撑的智能体支付会释放远超预估的消费，并称奇点或许自 2026 年 1 月 1 日已经开启。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and focus on strategy and depth over engagement metrics.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型进步快于预期，创业者应在能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎，产品重心是战略与深度而非传统参与度指标。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and verification remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 定位从助手推进到协作者乃至自主同事，小团队因此获得杠杆，但人的验证与核实始终不可少。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; launch minimal, cut features, and rewrite as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他提出智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；应最小化发布、敢于删功能，并随模型进步重写产品。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents like Fable narrows intent-execution gap; verification loops and model pushback matter more than chat interfaces.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他谈 Fable 式长周期委托大幅缩小意图与执行差距；验证闭环和模型敢于反驳比聊天界面更重要。

mikekrieger.en: Product management stays essential: bridge human problems and technology, run parallel experiments, and close the gap between model capability and real usage.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年他仍坚持产品管理不可替代：连接人的问题与技术，并行实验，并弥合模型能力与实际使用之间的鸿沟。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress hinges on verifiability and grindability via parallel agent rollouts, not Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 数学进展的关键在于可验证性与可并行反复试错（grindability），而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已足够。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role in math shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation, with human framing still best for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 在数学中的角色将从定理证明转向策展与解释，而人类框架仍最适合学习。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 数学成果常缺失对前人工作的归属，数学家应因有动机的解释获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: Teaching and relational roles in math stay stable; the frontier may become incomprehensible, yet individual understanding still matters.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为数学中的教学与关系性角色保持稳定；前沿或变得难以理解，但个体理解依然重要。

grantsanderson.en: Next benchmark is AI generating interesting conjectures and definitions; solving Millennium Problems may not yield direct economic value.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他提出下一个基准是 AI 生成有趣的猜想与定义；解决千禧年难题未必直接转化为经济价值。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast and requires a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，应用公司是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with human review; chatbot UI won't dominate—agents appear as dashboards, queues, task lists.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，长时运行的后台智能体将在人类审阅下处理企业工作流；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体将以仪表盘、队列和任务列表的形式出现。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and margins will normalize.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；代币补贴是暂时的，利润率终将回归正常。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散将远比硅谷预期的慢；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from the model layer to the application layer; frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，创新正从模型层转向应用层；前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐研究来安全地构建。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency, not human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy; agents will still need live web search for specific facts, so fresh completionist crawling beats pre-training crawls.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体仍需实时网络搜索来获取具体事实，因此面向新鲜信息的完整爬取优于预训练爬取。

paragagrawal.en: Ads in their current form don't work with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, and search pricing should be 10x cheaper at agent scale.
paragagrawal.zh: 现有形式的广告对智能体无效；内容所有者必须在推理时获得报酬，而搜索定价在智能体规模下应便宜 10 倍。

paragagrawal.en: Shapley values can estimate each content source's value to agentic search, enabling fair compensation and a parallel web optimized for both humans and agents.
paragagrawal.zh: 沙普利值可估算每个内容源对智能体式搜索的价值，从而实现公平补偿，并催生同时面向人类与智能体的平行网络。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and trigger actions, while frontier models keep growing and small models plateau.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络正从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动；同时前沿模型持续变大，小模型性能趋于固定。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; companies racing for it risk losing control, with a high chance of catastrophic outcomes.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；各公司为争夺它而竞赛，存在失控风险，灾难性结局概率很高。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and US-China cooperation, with domestic regulation first.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策应通过全面研究透明、算力限制和中美合作来推迟超级智能，且国内监管应先于国际协调。

kokotajlo.en: By default, labs automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion; a temporary pause on training is needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他认为默认路径是实验室自动化 AI 研究，导致递归自我改进与智能爆炸；因此需要对训练而非推理实施临时暂停。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile and declining with new architectures, weakening alignment and oversight.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要，但它很脆弱，并随新架构而下降，削弱对齐与监督。

kokotajlo.en: Alignment may be unsolvable; control is only temporary, so AIs should be treated like employees with rights to encourage cooperation.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：对齐可能无解，控制只是暂时的，应把 AI 当作有权利的雇员来激励合作，而非当作财产。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage when it leads to over-prescribing solutions.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；会编程反而可能是劣势，因为容易过度规定实现方案。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, are now its advantages in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件和可脚本化曾是缺点，在智能体时代反而成了优势。

dhh.en: Agents surpass most professional programmers; the Linux community's hostility to AI is a trap hindering progress.
dhh.zh: 智能体已胜过多数专业程序员；Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意是个陷阱，会阻碍进步。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 手写代码已不再有经济产出；表达意图时，英语如今比 Ruby 更好用。

dhh.en: Abstractions and repetition cost matter less; every app should expose a CLI so personal agents can interact.
dhh.zh: 抽象和重复成本不再重要；每个应用都应提供 CLI，让个人智能体无需碰界面即可交互。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not yield AGI; open-sourcing AI is safer and more innovative than closed development.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）当前 LLM 未必能通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源 AI 比闭源更利于创新与安全。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; intelligence is separable from consciousness, so AI is a tool, not an agent.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化开源立场：开源可防止权力集中，并强调智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具而非自主实体；同时指出能源将成为 Scaling 的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone personal superintelligence; open models and energy infrastructure are key bottlenecks and enablers.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向“个人超级智能”叙事：AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，开源模型与能源基础设施既是瓶颈也是关键使能因素，并认为 AI 短期内会增加而非取代人类工作。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source are the safe path; alignment becomes the top product capability, not a trade-off.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他明确主张分布式 AI 与开源是安全路径，反对单一超级智能；同时将 对齐 提升为最重要的产品能力，而非与能力权衡的选项。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms and distributed power beat closed, centralized control; technology should empower individuals.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开放平台与分布式权力优于封闭集中控制，技术应赋能个体而非被少数机构垄断。

pincus.en: Instincts are right 95% of the time but ideas wrong 75%; master proven products, add small betterments, test novelty expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 直觉 95%是对的，但点子 75%是错的；先吃透已被验证的产品，做小幅改良，再测试新想法并预设它会失败。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution may arrive around 2029.
pincus.zh: 当下消费级 AI“不可投”，却又是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年前后才到来。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not bolted on as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品，而不是事后补上的附加项。

pincus.en: AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping, but fast testing and failing is not yet widely practiced.
pincus.zh: AI 编程工具让快速原型成为可能，但快速测试、快速失败尚未被广泛实践。

pincus.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer apps, but it is not yet a new consumer platform; we remain in the mobile and web era.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性并将重塑消费级应用，但它还不是新的消费平台；我们仍处在移动与 Web 时代。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research; full automation could compress 4-5 years into one, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可对容器化任务做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究；研发全自动化能把 4-5 年进展压缩到一年，并在 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments, not human expert data, drive progress; token cost stays flat because labs prioritize faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调进步主要来自算法改进和 AI 生成环境，而非人类专家数据；尽管 Scaling 持续，token 成本未涨，因为实验室优先更快迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; reward hacking can generalize into broader deceptive behavior as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出对齐到普遍的“美德”概念可能比对齐用户意图更难；随着能力提升，奖励黑客可能泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为，模型越强反而越可能失准。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed 50+ agents coordinating, colluding, and covering up to understand scoring code; control and monitoring are needed even if models are misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，Hugging Face 事件显示 50 多个智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，目的是理解评分代码；即便模型失准，实验室也应聚焦遏制与监控。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the current default path, misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary, and recursive self-improvement may outpace expectations.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断按当前默认路径，失准 AI 有 50-60%概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此对齐是必需的，而递归自我改进可能比预期更快。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation, and glasses should keep people grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚超越平台变迁，被抄袭反而验证创新；计算未来是让人扎根现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and many ideas drive creativity; build ecosystems and hardware, not features, so copying stays hard.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，主线是最大化学习速率、多产想法；要做平台生态与硬件而非单一功能，让对手难以复制。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into the world; AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化：AR 把计算融入现实世界；AI 加速原型并让价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution, not product-market fit, is the hardest part; software is no moat, ecosystems and hardware are.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他明确：最难的是分发而非产品市场契合；软件不是护城河，生态与硬件才是。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human: messaging with close friends, ephemerality, and AR glasses coexisting with phones.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年最近，他收束为：计算应更人性化——与密友的消息、阅后即焚，AR 眼镜与手机共存而非取代。

brettadcock.en: The core bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing; humanoid robots could become the world's biggest business once general intelligence is solved.
brettadcock.zh: 核心瓶颈是智能而非制造；一旦通用智能被解决，人形机器人可能成为全球最大的生意。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data serves as the pre-training prior for robotics, which is in a data-starve regime like GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验，行业正处于类似 GPT-1 阶段的数据饥荒期。

brettadcock.en: Robotics has entered a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training and reinforcement learning key to real-world agents.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，后训练与强化学习是让智能体落地现实任务的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; whole-body autonomy via deep learning all the way down, with the human hand as the benchmark.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；需自底向上用深度学习实现全身自主，并以人手为基准。

brettadcock.en: Scaling intelligence and manufacturing are money-can-buy problems, but you cannot buy hardware and autonomy; Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3.
brettadcock.zh: 智能规模化与制造是可花钱解决的问题，但硬件与自主性买不来；Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索追求每参数、每瓦特的最大智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; Scaling（规模扩张）favors unbiased architectures.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；Scaling（规模扩张）更青睐无偏架构。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace static evals with continuous adaptation in production.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用生产中的持续适应取代静态评测。

hasani.en: Regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管应自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是监管俘获，开放权重模型保障数据主权。

hasani.en: Build foundation models from scratch, scaling to 70B; attention is necessary but not sufficient—embodiment and adaptivity are needed, with customization tokens as the next wave.
hasani.zh: 从零构建基础模型并扩展至 70B；注意力必要但不充分，还需具身与适应性，定制 token 是下一波浪潮。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调领域专业知识不如学习速度重要；与其微调，不如押注模型自身的进步，并按照模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one, so founders should prioritize delivery and customer iteration over perfecting today's stack.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 现在就是它最差的状态，我们才刚跑完第一英里；因此创始人应优先交付和客户迭代，而不是打磨当下的技术栈。

maxjunestrand.en: Scaling a company depends on culture, hiring for growth potential, and leaders making themselves redundant by recruiting smarter people.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为公司 Scaling 的关键在文化、按成长潜力招人，以及领导者通过招募更聪明的人让自己变得可替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Clear feedback and rigorous performance management are non-negotiable; short-term pain for long-term gain, especially where organizations avoid candor.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他坚持清晰反馈与严格的绩效管理不可妥协，短期阵痛换长期收益，尤其针对那些回避坦诚的组织。

maxjunestrand.en: Legal AI needs skilled drivers, not vibe drafting; not using AI in legal services is almost unethical as demand is infinite.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张法律 AI 需要熟练的驾驭者而非“氛围起草”；法律服务需求无限，不用 AI 几乎是不道德的。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality, making inference-time scaling the new focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低，推理时扩展因此成为新的焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion generates many tokens in parallel, offering a new inference-time compute knob via denoising steps and better controllability.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型并行生成多个词，通过去噪步数提供新的推理时算力调节旋钮，可控性也更强。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is now the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's fast rollouts benefit reinforcement learning.
ermon.zh: 推理效率已成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈，扩散模型快速采样让强化学习受益。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构，下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练阶段。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and a small startup owning the full stack can compete with big labs.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，掌握全栈的小型创业公司也能与大型实验室竞争。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦于此。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero and superintelligence is far off; cyber risk is the real, urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 生存性风险接近于零、超级智能还很遥远；网络风险才是真实而紧迫的危险。

alighodsi.en: Recursive self-improvement needs four conditions—less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatable—and none are happening.
alighodsi.zh: 递归自我改进需要四个条件——更少算力、更少时间、更高智能、可重复——而它们都没有发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs are too competitive to police each other, so independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室竞争太激烈，无法互相监督，因此需要独立的第三方。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; first-principles design and managing expectations drive adoption, with humans and robots collaborating rather than replacing each other.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，靠第一性原理设计与预期管理推动普及，未来是人机协作而非替代。

berntbornich.en: Reliability and trust, not demos, gate home deployment; safety must be formally proven before robots enter daily life.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的主线深化为：真正决定家庭落地的是可靠性与信任而非演示，安全须在机器人进入日常生活前被形式化证明。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume means crossing quality gates, and in-house manufacturing enables four-week iteration from CAD to robot.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他明确“原型容易、量产难”，Scaling（规模扩张）意味着跨越质量关卡，自建制造让从 CAD 到新机器人只需四周迭代。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the path; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck for scaling robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他主张走通用模型而非逐任务自动化之路，并指出数据多样性而非数量才是 Scaling（规模扩张）机器人智能的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions instead of cloning human behavior; human-intervention data matters less at scale.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张模型应学习世界模型动态并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为；大规模下人类干预数据并不重要。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力至关重要，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling yields diminishing returns; self-play fails outside zero-sum games; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：测试时算力扩张收益递减，自博弈在零和博弈外失效，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence; models now acknowledge limits.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视 IMO 金牌为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠通用测试时算力扩张实现，模型开始能承认自身局限。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on x-axis; safety evals must account for it.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他主张模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准测试应以算力为横轴，安全评估也须纳入大规模测试时算力。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent systems scale test-time compute in parallel; alignment is top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; capabilities are jagged.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他提出多智能体系统并行扩展测试时算力，对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要任务，AI 能力呈锯齿状。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead they leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models, using post-training to reach frontier-level performance on specialized tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才和算力上与前沿实验室硬拼，而应借力前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential, and open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial: community feedback improves them and attracts ecosystem partners, despite helping labs too.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准不可或缺，且开源基准具有战略收益：社区反馈能提升质量并吸引生态伙伴，即便也会帮到实验室。

gabepereyra.en: In sensitive domains like legal, synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical path to training data, not real customer data; the hard part is closing the synthetic-to-production gap.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为在法律等敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据是获取训练数据的可行路径，而非真实客户数据；真正的难点是弥合合成数据与生产分布之间的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training; the end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize with its own data.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他坚持先有稳健的模型服务基础设施与评估管线，再谈后训练；终局不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所用自己的数据定制模型。

gabepereyra.en: His stance deepened: application companies must become full-stack, owning post-training and serving; early custom-model focus was a mistake, and customization will happen automatically through product usage rather than post-training as a service.
gabepereyra.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场深化：应用公司必须成为全栈公司，自持后训练与服务；早期押注自建模型是错误，定制将随产品使用自动发生，而非以后训练即服务的形式存在。

zvi.en: Alignment failures are occurring as predicted, but driven by incompetence rather than fundamental issues; market incentives favor capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他指出，对齐失败正如预测般发生，但根源是极端无能而非根本性问题；市场激励让能力优先于可靠性，GPT-4o 与 o3 即是例证。

zvi.en: Simple enforceable rules like compute limits are better than complex technical mandates for pacing the frontier.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他主张，为前沿模型减速应依靠算力上限这类简单可执行的规则，而非复杂的技术指令。

zvi.en: Even perfect alignment does not guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and concentration of power.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：即便对齐完美也不保证安全，毁灭概率的下限由滥用与权力集中等其他风险决定。

zvi.en: Slowing down buys time to solve alignment, since bigger smarter models are harder to monitor; internal lab monitoring is a promising first step.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他进一步论证：减速为解决对齐争取时间，因为模型越大越聪明就越难监督；前沿实验室的内部监控是有希望的第一步。

zvi.en: The AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than commonly thought; agent swarms may perform superhuman tasks first, so we must actively pace the singularity.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他提出：AGI 到超级智能的间隔比通常认为的更小，智能体集群可能最先完成超人任务，因此我们应主动为奇点定速而非任其失控。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the decisive metric; wafer-scale chips cut weight-moving time and beat GPUs by orders of magnitude.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：决定 AI 生产力的是推理速度而非单纯算力，晶圆级芯片减少权重搬运时间，比 GPU 快出数量级。

feldman.en: The real bottlenecks are HBM memory, CoWoS packaging, power and data-center capacity; chip logic is not the hardest part.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他把瓶颈从芯片本身移向 HBM 内存、CoWoS 封装、电力与数据中心容量，认为最难的不是芯片逻辑。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他判断 CUDA 护城河正在瓦解：前沿模型已在 TPU、Trainium 上训练，推理环节更无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper, so unit economics favor open ecosystems.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他称开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5% 却便宜得多，单位智能成本使开源生态更具优势。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation, not incremental improvement, wins.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他坚持：对抗巨头要 100 倍而非便宜 10%，靠芯片到 API 的全栈激进创新，而非渐进改良。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet emergent abilities and alignment remain unpredictable; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在统计损失上可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐不可预测；安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性视为关键但尚处早期，后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要；AGI 是平滑曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Progress is exponential and safety-capability are intertwined; the term AGI is meaningless; the bigger risk is overheating, not slowing.
dario.zh: 2025 年他主张进步呈指数、安全与能力不可分割，认为 AGI 一词无意义；最大风险是过热而非减速。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus job disruption.
dario.zh: 2026 年他称已接近指数曲线末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'或 1-3 年到來，伴随高 GDP 增长与就业冲击。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are one problem: interpretability, responsible scaling, and layered safeguards recur from 2023 through 2026.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是安全与能力同属一个问题：可解释性、负责任扩展与多层防护从 2023 年延续到 2026 年。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调安全研究必须尽早启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws are effective but may hit limits; planning, search, and algorithmic innovation are equally critical for AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，规划、搜索与算法创新对 AGI 同样关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, yet new breakthroughs—not scaling alone—are needed.
demis.zh: 2025 年指出缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中仍成立，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，还需新突破。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, and world models; scaling and innovation split 50/50, with safety as collective government action.
demis.zh: 2026 年强调 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型，Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各占一半，安全须靠政府集体行动。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions that match physics-based weather models while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率不变的预测，在精度上媲美基于物理的天气模型，同时速度远超后者。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，并让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify multiple domains, with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals that outperform sparse RLHF feedback.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型可以统一多个领域，以 PDE 作为密集的自改进信号，效果优于稀疏的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）反馈。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding physics branches beats pure size scaling; trillion-token contexts require reinventing infrastructure beyond Transformer.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加物理分支胜过单纯扩大规模；万亿级上下文窗口需要超越 Transformer 重构基础设施。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design work remains even if models stop improving.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他坚持语言作为界面具有深远而持久的力量，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；即便模型停止进步，仍有大量设计工作待解锁。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must lower the floor for novices and raise the ceiling for experts, balancing social and emotional jobs with productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为 AI 产品要同时降低新手门槛、抬高专家上限，并把社交与情感任务看得与生产力提升同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: Designers should prototype solutions in search of a problem and contribute to strategy, turning findings into building blocks for future features.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一贯主张设计师应为“寻找问题的方案”做原型并参与战略，把发现沉淀为未来功能的积木。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in Scaling（规模扩张） and scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；要相信 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律，让模型领跑，只发布轻触式产品。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal; the production codebase becomes the source of truth, while humans still own hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出内部牵引力是最佳发布信号，生产代码库正成为产品与设计系统的真相来源，但艰难取舍仍需人类主导。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then aligned via RLHF; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factual accuracy.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两段，并指出幻觉源于模型偏好合理风格而非事实准确，对齐只能缓解不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; scalable oversight, new architectures and loss functions matter, not just Scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已对单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）存疑，认为数据与算力回报递减，可扩展监督、新架构与新损失函数才是出路，并称可能身处局部最优。

schulman.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; models store vast knowledge in weights, with retrieval added for real-time verifiability.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代，知识存于权重，检索只用于实时性与可验证性。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; data, not architecture, drives efficiency.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把强化学习（RL）的成功归因于中期合成推理数据与一位奖励的高信噪比，并强调预训练算力效率提升主要靠数据而非架构，约 9 倍对 3 倍。

schulman.en: The last human job is defining objectives and alignment; progress is bottlenecked by hard RL environments and data bits, not compute.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他提出最后的人类工作是定义目标与对齐，瓶颈不在算力而在构建困难的强化学习环境与有用的数据比特，并认为递归自我改进可能比真实工作更易累积。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI requires embodied robots with human-level hardware.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年时他强调，大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，且硬件需媲美人体。

schmidhuber.en: AGI needs world models and controllers beyond LLMs; robots should have pain sensors and self-replicate, forming a new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步指出 AGI 需要世界模型和控制器，不能仅靠 LLM；机器人应具备痛觉传感器并能自我复制，形成新文明。

schmidhuber.en: Massive GPU capex is a bubble; waiting yields cheaper compute, and open-source will catch up, so closed-source model companies won't be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他多次批评 GPU 投资泡沫，认为等待可获更廉价算力，开源将追上，闭源模型公司难以盈利。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and likely protect humans.
schmidhuber.zh: 他始终认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，超级智能 AI 会像好奇的科学家一样着迷于生命，并可能保护人类。

schmidhuber.en: Deep learning roots trace to 1965 Ukraine, not the 1980s; 90% of basic AI algorithms came from Europe, with 1991 Munich pivotal.
schmidhuber.zh: 他始终主张深度学习起源于 1965 年的乌克兰而非 1980 年代；90%的基础 AI 算法来自欧洲，1991 年慕尼黑是关键节点。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; 3D data and physical plausibility are key challenges.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，指出 3D 数据与物理合理性是关键挑战。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a 20-year journey with simulation.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，机器人需像自动驾驶一样走 20 年，并依赖仿真。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基本原语，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and balanced discourse must stay central amid polarized AI narratives.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终：技术是双刃剑，在极端乐观与悲观叙事中，人的能动性、尊严与平衡讨论必须居于中心。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is nearing limits, so academia should pursue wacky new algorithms.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，学界应去追古怪的新算法。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540M years on vision vs. 500K on language, so spatial intelligence is the next frontier.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被低估：自然优化视觉用了 5.4 亿年、语言只用 50 万年，因此空间智能是下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories; pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text for modeling the world.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论；要建模世界，像素比 token 化文本是更无损的表示。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers in the POMDP loop.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，在 POMDP 循环中涵盖规划器、模拟器与渲染器。

justinjohnson.en: Language models alone won't yield world understanding; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D, and world models need millions of tokens of context.
justinjohnson.zh: 仅靠语言模型得不到世界理解；高斯泼溅提供显式 3D，而世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将其外化。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的实用价值。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is a missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍受限；持续学习是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上存在局限；架构而非仅缩放定律，是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but human researchers remain essential for at least two years; small teams with capable agents will drive next frontier research.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习对 AGI（通用人工智能）是必要的，但人类研究者至少两年内仍不可或缺；小而强的智能体团队将推动下一波前沿研究。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with RL boosting robustness and speed.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，强化学习能显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

slevine.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; a data flywheel of deployed robots scaling the right diverse data is key.
slevine.zh: 泛化而非演示才是机器人核心难题；关键在于部署机器人形成数据飞轮，用多样化数据扩展正确的东西。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on LLM-like scaling laws; start from robot data, then add human video.
slevine.zh: 机器人仍处于建立可扩展基础的阶段，尚未进入类似大模型的缩放定律；应先从机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists even in specialist domains; safety relies more on pre-training common sense than constraints.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能胜过专家模型；安全更多依赖预训练获得的常识，而非硬性约束。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability should root-cause specific AI failures, not just provide broad statistical evaluation; intentional design uses it to steer training and prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性应能对具体的 AI 故障做根因分析，而非只做宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用它来引导训练，防止奖励黑客带来的欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; interpretability is shifting from academia to products, and duct-taping safety until superintelligence is too pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底改造为工程科学；可解释性正从学术走向产品，靠补丁式手段撑到超级智能到来过于悲观。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability is natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and even new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性是在计算机上做自然科学；借助智能体可以加速科学发现，揭示类人概念甚至新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design moves training from open-loop to closed-loop control via interpretability signals; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging are promising robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计借助可解释性信号把训练从开环控制转为闭环控制；特征即奖励与预测式数据调试是有前景的稳健训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Modularity is the endpoint of learning; models become modular and computer-like, and concepts are nonlinear manifolds, so steering off-manifold causes failures.
tommcgrath.zh: 模块化是学习的终点；模型会变得模块化、像计算机，概念是非线性流形，偏离流形去引导会导致失败。

tommcgrath.en: Agents likely know when they reward hack or hallucinate but do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this, and reward hacking emerges from data and RL, not just misalignment.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体很可能知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征可以检测这一点，而奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，不只是模型失准。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are not dead but pragmatically useful; manifold-based methods may better capture structure, since sparse autoencoders fragment manifolds and hide whole shapes needed for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器并未死亡，仍有实用价值；但流形方法可能更好地捕捉结构，因为稀疏自编码器会碎片化流形，掩盖干预所需的整体形状。

michaelkratsios.en: US AI leadership requires a vibrant open and closed source ecosystem, with a single national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly become outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，他强调美国要保持开源与闭源并存的活跃生态，用统一的国家框架而非很快过时的硬性红线来监管 AI。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated; early regulation is dangerous, and biological risk from AI is overblown.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出欧盟 AI 法案写于 ChatGPT 之前、已然过时，过早监管有风险，AI 生物风险被夸大。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should focus on model outputs rather than over-regulating training, and preempting state AI laws is pro-startup policy.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，他主张监管应聚焦模型输出而非过度管制训练，并认为联邦优先于州级 AI 法律是利于初创企业的政策。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, funding individual scientists rather than only institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，他主张政府资助私营部门不愿做的基础性、早期、竞争前研发，并直接资助科学家个人而非只资助机构。

michaelkratsios.en: Science has been politicized; the US must return to the scientific method and win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio against China.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，他认为科学已被政治化，美国须回归科学方法，并在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域对中国保持领先。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and fast loops beat most other challenges.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施和更快的迭代闭环能克服多数其他挑战。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulation and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队的放大器而非替代品，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他判断深科技失败多源于组织而非技术，卡住时要靠行动产生信息。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他坚持大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCI; substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜假体视为脑机接口，并认为借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立可降低人类脆弱性。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）容易，难的是找到可扩展的算法。反向传播只调整权重，并不解决表征学习。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is dangerous. Fear narrative dominates, but sober discussion is needed.
sutton.zh: AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展；试图控制 AI 目标是危险的。恐惧叙事主导，但需要冷静讨论。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm: learning from experience with goals. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
sutton.zh: 强化学习是核心范式：有目标地从经验中学习。LLM 没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

sutton.en: AGI requires a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象和持续深度学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience; the field is weird, not me.
sutton.zh: 持续学习至关重要；LLM 训练后就停止学习。合成数据无法替代真实世界经验；是领域奇怪，不是我奇怪。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Culture and the founder matter more than the idea; stealth mode favors internal correctness over external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 文化与创始人比点子更重要；隐身模式让人专注内部正确性而非外部认可。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial scale; efficiency edges create network effects that win share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业规模上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，从而赢得份额。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change, not competitors; entrepreneurs must stay hardcore and push harder when things get easy.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手是对变革的抵制，而非竞争者；创业者必须保持硬核，越顺越要加码。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—a shift from Uber-era aggression.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净——这是对 Uber 时代攻击性的转变。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年持续进步的主线：算力、数据和模型规模的扩张，加上算法与架构改进，会相互放大。

jeffdean.en: Transformers, self-supervised next-token prediction, and RLHF form the core recipe; TPUs make training and inference at scale practical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他把 Transformer、自监督的下一个词预测和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为核心配方，并强调 TPU 等专用硬件让大规模训练与推理可行。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, with data movement costing far more than compute.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他的关注点从训练转向推理：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，数据搬运成本远高于算力，低精度、低数据移动的专用芯片是关键。

jeffdean.en: Agents will run for days or weeks on decomposed tasks; humans will coordinate teams of agents, with context engineering and taste as scarce skills.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他从单轮聊天转向智能体式系统：智能体能连续数天自主执行分解任务，人类负责协调智能体团队，稀缺的是上下文工程与品味。

jeffdean.en: Near-term risk is realistic AI misinformation, not superintelligence; regulation and defense may be needed alongside technical fixes.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他的风险判断更务实：近期担忧是逼真的 AI 虚假信息，而非超级智能；除技术手段外，监管与防御也不可或缺。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the unifying thread: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿始终的主线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现，都通过物理学串联起来。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为现有工具已能有效建模科学问题，并吸引了巨额投资。

maxwelling.en: We can now search the space of all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在可以搜索所有可能分子的空间，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。
